sn11.20:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ Jetavane || || Tatra kho || la || avoca || || Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Mātalisaṅgāhakam āmantesi || || Yojehi samma Mātali sahassayuttam ājaññarathaṃ || uyyānabhūmim gacchāma subhumiṃ dassanāyā ti || || Evaṃ bhadanta vā ti kho bhikkhave Mātali-saṅgāhako Sakkassa devānam indassa paṭissutvā sahassayuttam ajaññarathaṃ yojetvā Sakkassa devānam indassa paṭivedesi || || Yutto kho te mārisa sahassayutto ājaññaratho yassa dāni kālam maññasīti || || Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Vejayantapāsādā orohanto pañjaliko sudam bhikkhu-saṅghaṃ namassati || || Atha kho bhikkhave Mātali-saṅgāhako Sakkaṃ devānam indaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn11.20:2.1: Taṃ hi ete namasseyyuṃ || pūtidehasayā narā || nimuggā kuṇapesvete || khuppipāsā samappitā || ||
sn11.20:3.1: Kiṃ nu tesam pihayasi || anāgārāna Vasava || ācāram isīnaṃ brūhi || taṃ suṇoma vaco tavā ti || ||
sn11.20:4.1: Etaṃ tesaṃ pihayāmi || anāgārāna Mātali || yamhā gāmā pakkamanti || anapekhā vajanti te ||
sn11.20:5.1: na tesaṃ koṭṭhe openti || na kumbhā na kaḷopiyaṃ || paraniṭṭhitam esānā || tena yāpenti subbatā || ||
sn11.20:6.1: sumantamantīno dhīrā || tuṇhībhūtā samañcarā || devā viruddhā asurehi || puthumaccā ca Mātali || ||
sn11.20:7.1: Aviruddhā viruddhesu || attadaṇḍesu nibbutā || sādānesu anādānā || te namassāmi Mātalī ti ||
sn11.20:8.1: Seṭṭhā hi kira lokasmiṃ || ye tvaṃ Sakka namassasi || aham pi te namassāmi || ye namassasi Vāsava || || Idaṃ
sn11.20:9.1: vatvāna Maghavā || devarājā Sujampati || bhikkhusaṅghaṃ namassitvā || pamukho ratham āruhī ti || || Dutiyo vaggo || ||
sn11.20:10.0: Tass-uddānam || || Devā pana tayo vuttā || Daliddañ ca Rāmaṇeyyakaṃ || Yajamānañ ca Vandanā || tayo Sakkanamassanā ti || || ___________________________________________
